channel.title: Entra.News Daily
channel.description: A readable record of what changed across Microsoft Entra documentation and Message Center.

item.title: Configure Zscaler Provisioning for automatic user provisioning with Microsoft Entra ID
item.description: Microsoft added a tutorial describing how to configure automatic user provisioning and deprovisioning between Microsoft Entra ID and Zscaler Provisioning, including user and group synchronization, prerequisites, SCIM setup, application-gallery configuration, scoping, and attribute mapping.

item.title: Customize Application Attributes
item.description: The application attribute customization documentation now links the LCW extensibility workflow mapping type to a separate article explaining how to extend attribute mappings with these workflows.

item.title: Extend Application Attributes
item.description: The documentation now explains how to use Microsoft Graph Explorer to create custom task extensions and extensibility workflows, including required permissions, sample requests, and responses. The workflow example is labeled Preview.

item.title: How to connect a remote network when your CPE is behind NAT - Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
item.description: A new how-to explains configuring a Global Secure Access remote network when the CPE has a private WAN address behind an upstream NAT router, using IKEv2 NAT Traversal (NAT-T) over UDP 4500. It covers topology, prerequisites, and setup considerations.

item.title: Product names and service plan identifiers for licensing
item.description: The documentation now includes Azure portal licensing management, refreshes product and service-plan identifier entries, adds Agent 365, and states the table was last updated August 3, 2026.

item.title: Sms Voice Retirement
item.description: The page now documents the retirement timeline, passkey auto-enablement beginning September 1, 2026, and loss of SMS/voice MFA without a customer-managed telecom provider from February 1, 2027. It also covers costs, SSPR, scope, and a temporary opt-out.

item.title: How to manage the Internet Access profile
item.description: The article now describes traffic forwarding through the Global Secure Access client and remote networks, six policies instead of three, Microsoft Traffic Bypass, Custom Acquire, and Agentic Acquire. It also expands Custom Bypass configuration steps to cover destination types, ports, and protocols.

item.title: Automatic Governance Relationships
item.description: When you create a new Microsoft Entra tenant using the secure add-on tenant creation feature, you're prompted to select an existing subscription and resource group from your billing account. When you create your new tenant, Microsoft generates a new billing asset called **Entra ID Free** under that subscription and resource group, which links to the newly created tenant.

item.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of custom CSS positioning properties in custom branding
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire support for custom CSS positioning properties in company branding starting October 2026 to enhance security and phishing resistance. Existing users must remove these properties by then, as no migration path exists. Branding elements remain visible but may revert to default placement.

item.title: Road to the cloud: Introduction
item.description: Organizations are increasingly modernizing identity, access, and device management by reducing their dependence on on-premises Active Directory and adopting cloud-native capabilities in Microsoft Entra ID. Whether the goal is complete Active Directory retirement or a smaller, more secure on-premises footprint, this guidance helps you plan and execute that transformation.

item.title: Upcoming Conditional Access change: Improved enforcement for policies with resource exclusions
item.description: Starting June 15, 2026, Conditional Access policies targeting All resources with exclusions will be enforced for sign-ins requesting only certain OIDC or directory scopes. Some users may face new challenges like MFA. Most organizations need no action, but custom apps requesting only these scopes should be evaluated.

item.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Optimizations for passkey registration experience
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration via Registration Campaign, Authentication Strengths, and My Sign-Ins to improve compliance with passkey policies and prioritize local device passkeys. These changes, rolling out in late August 2026, require no user interface changes or action from organizations.
